definitions.name: N_local
definitions.source_text: let N_local[a in age] = S[a] + E[a] + I[a] + R[a]

transitions.name: infection
transitions.source_text:
infection[a in age] : S[a] --> E[a]
    @ beta * S[a] * sum(b in age, C_age[a, b] * I[b] / N_local[b])

transitions.name: progression
transitions.source_text: progression[a in age] : E[a] --> I[a]  @ sigma * E[a]

transitions.name: recovery
transitions.source_text: recovery[a in age]    : I[a] --> R[a]  @ gamma * I[a]

transitions.name: aging
transitions.source_text:
aging[c in compartments, (a, a_next) in consecutive(age)]
    : c[a] --> c[a_next]
    @ aging_rate[a] * c[a]

scenarios.name: baseline
